interface.signature: def morganAndString(a: str, b: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in a) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both input strings a and b contain only uppercase letters (A-Z).
Both input strings a and b are non-empty.

postconditions.description: The output string contains all characters from both input strings a and b exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(c in a + b for c in return_value) and all(c in return_value for c in a + b)
postconditions.description: The output string is a permutation of the concatenation of a and b.

postconditions.expression: not any(return_value < morganAndString(a, b) for a in [''.join(sorted(a)), ''.join(sorted(b))] if len(a) == len(a) + len(b))
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically minimal among all possible permutations of a + b.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == return_value[j] or return_value[i] < return_value[j] for i in range(len(return_value)) for j in range(i + 1, len(return_value)) if return_value[i] != return_value[j])
postconditions.description: The output string is constructed by always choosing the lexicographically smaller character available at the top of either stack at each step.
